name: 26312-mtpdecode-qwen35-27b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B, bf16, 55.6 GB over 11 shards, apache-2.0, ungated. The largest member of the family that fits one 80 GB card.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of an a3 node. One card, and the whole model on it.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. Nothing is sharded.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 256 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. 231 requests are measured.
workload: 256 mathematics problems from `zwhe99/DeepMath-103K`, committed as `configs/data/deepmath-256.jsonl`: one problem per request, single turn, no shared prefix, consumed in file order. Prompts are the raw problem statements, 31-258 tokens (median 73). Generation is pinned at exactly 1024 tokens with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 1.0`; top_p and top_k are left at their defaults.
purpose: A math tutoring service solving competition problems with a 27B model, eight concurrent users, long fixed-length answers, one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- the parser DROPS nested blocks, and a dropped block would mean the
# engine runs without something this file declares. A bool is a FLAG: `true` emits `--key`,
# `false` emits nothing.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B
tp-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

speculative-algorithm: NEXTN
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

disable-radix-cache: true
max-running-requests: 8
context-length: 4096
attention-backend: fa3
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 26312

# `speculative-adaptive` is deliberately absent and must stay absent: its default adaptive
# config turns drafting off entirely at the batch size this item runs, so the engine would
# serve without speculative decoding at all.
